title: Amyhohoilam
requirements: Technical creation of a multi-jointed fantasy goblin character model from high-fidelity artwork. Specifications included Roblox-compliant R15 block styles, layered apparel compatibility, and a specialized 5-finger articulated hand layout. The model was designed to perform in high-resolution promotional marketing material, UI rendering, and in-game cinematic behaviors.
achievements: Engineered a custom five-finger hand structure exceeding native locomotion models
Achieved layered-clothing warp stability across organic, bulbous biological geometry
Designed and delivered structural dynamic joint rig validation videos for the studio's animation team
